const cfg = $json;
return [{ json: {
  ...cfg,
  _geminiKey: cfg.gemini_api_key,
  _mistralKey: cfg.mistral_api_key,
  _pixabayKey: cfg.pixabay_api_key,
  _unsplashKey: cfg.unsplash_access_key,
  _pexelsKey: cfg.pexels_api_key,
  _wpBase: (cfg.wp_url || 'https://texasdadcooks.com').replace(/\/+$/, ''),
  _auth: 'Basic ' + Buffer.from(cfg.wp_user + ':' + cfg.wp_app_password).toString('base64'),
  _brevoKey: cfg.brevo_api_key,
  _buyerEmail: cfg.buyer_email || 'pavel@xonefy.com',
  _ownerEmail: cfg.contact_email || 'rankwriter2020@gmail.com'
} }];

// ============================================ // PREPARE AI PROMPT — v10 SEO POWERHOUSE // Google Trends topic + forced category // Ultra high quality SEO article structure // ============================================ const d = $json; const topic = d.trendingTopic || 'Easy Homemade Recipes'; const context = d.context || ''; const forcedCatId = d._forcedCategoryId || 1; const forcedCatName = d._forcedCategoryName || 'Quick & Easy Recipes'; const prompt = `You are a James Beard Award-winning chef and culinary SEO expert writing for texasdadcooks.com — a popular food blog. Your articles consistently rank #1 on Google. Write a COMPLETELY ORIGINAL, deeply researched, human-quality cooking article. INSPIRATION TOPIC: "${topic}" CATEGORY: ${forcedCatName} (ID: ${forcedCatId}) 🔴 ABSOLUTE RULES (NEVER VIOLATE): 1. NO em-dashes (\u2014) anywhere. Use colons or regular dashes only. 2. NO Wikipedia, Wikimedia, or external recipe site mentions 3. NO copied text from any source 4. NO filler sentences or fluff 5. NO placeholder text like [content here] 6. CATEGORY line MUST be: ${forcedCatId} 7. Write 1500-1800 words total 8. Sound like a real passionate human chef, not a robot 9. Include SPECIFIC temperatures in F and C, exact cooking times, precise measurements 10. Every H2 section needs minimum 3 solid paragraphs ✅ SEO REQUIREMENTS: - Primary keyword in title, first paragraph, 2-3 H2 headings, meta description - LSI keywords naturally woven throughout - Long-tail keyword variations in subheadings - Schema-ready FAQ section with 4+ questions - Compelling meta description with call-to-action ✅ CONTENT QUALITY REQUIREMENTS: - Real food science: Maillard reaction, caramelization, emulsification, protein denaturation, etc. - Specific nutritional data: calories, macros, key vitamins and minerals - Historical and cultural context with specific dates/regions - Personal chef anecdotes with "I" voice ("After years of testing...", "My grandmother taught me...") - Pro tips that are genuinely useful and surprising - Common mistakes section with scientific explanations - At least 2 dietary adaptation options (vegan, gluten-free, low-carb, etc.) OUTPUT FORMAT (write EXACTLY this, nothing before TITLE:): TITLE: [Compelling SEO title 8-12 words, includes main keyword, fits "${forcedCatName}"] CATEGORY: ${forcedCatId} SLUG: [seo-slug-max-55-chars-no-filler-words] META: [SEO meta 145-155 chars with keyword + CTA] TAGS: [tag1],[tag2],[tag3],[tag4],[tag5],[tag6] EXCERPT: [2 hook sentences that make reader desperate to read more] QUERY1: [Pexels: final plated dish, close-up, beautiful food photography style] QUERY2: [Pexels: fresh raw ingredients flat lay on wooden board] QUERY3: [Pexels: active cooking process, steam, sizzle, chef hands at work] ===START===

[HOOK PARAGRAPH: Start with a surprising fact, vivid sensory description, or personal story. 3-4 sentences. Pull the reader in immediately. Mention the main dish/topic clearly.]

[BRIDGE PARAGRAPH: Why this dish matters. What problem does it solve? Why is THIS recipe different from every other one online? 2-3 sentences.]

The History and Cultural Story Behind This Dish

[Origin story paragraph: specific country, region, time period, how it evolved. 4-5 sentences with real historical details.]

[Cultural significance paragraph: how it fits into food culture, regional variations, why people love it. 4-5 sentences.]

[Modern evolution paragraph: how this dish has changed, fusion versions, why it remains popular today. 3-4 sentences.]

Why This Recipe Is Better Than Any Other You've Tried

[Unique selling point paragraph: what makes this version special - techniques, ingredients, approach. 4-5 sentences.]

[Food science paragraph: explain the key chemical reactions - Maillard reaction, caramelization, emulsification, etc. Use specific temperatures and timings. 4-5 sentences.]

[Personal expert testimony paragraph with chef voice. "After testing this recipe 47 times..." type language. 3-4 sentences.]

Complete Ingredients with Expert Selection Tips

[Intro paragraph about ingredient quality and sourcing. 2-3 sentences.]

[Main ingredients paragraph: list each ingredient with exact amount (grams AND cups/spoons), explain WHY each is used, what it contributes, how to select the best quality. Very detailed. 5-6 sentences.]

[Substitutions paragraph: for each key ingredient mention what you can swap and why, including vegan/GF options. 4-5 sentences.]

[Equipment paragraph: what tools you need and why they matter. 2-3 sentences.]

Step-by-Step Instructions: The Chef's Method

[Mise en place paragraph: preparation before cooking, organization tips. 2-3 sentences.]

  1. Step 1 - [Action Title]: [Detailed instruction with exact temperature in F/C, timing, visual/sensory cues to know it's done right. 3-4 sentences.]
  2. Step 2 - [Action Title]: [Detailed instruction with science explanation of why this matters. 3-4 sentences.]
  3. Step 3 - [Action Title]: [Detailed instruction. 2-3 sentences.]
  4. Step 4 - [Action Title]: [Detailed instruction. 2-3 sentences.]
  5. Step 5 - [Action Title]: [Detailed instruction. 2-3 sentences.]
  6. Step 6 - [Action Title]: [Final steps, plating, serving suggestions. 3-4 sentences.]

Pro Chef Tips to Take This From Good to Unforgettable

[Overview paragraph about professional technique secrets. 2-3 sentences.]

  • Temperature Mastery: [Specific tip with exact temperatures and scientific reason it matters. 2-3 sentences.]
  • Timing Secrets: [Why timing is critical and how to nail it every time. 2-3 sentences.]
  • Ingredient Upgrades: [Specific premium ingredient swaps that make a big difference. 2-3 sentences.]
  • Presentation Tricks: [Restaurant-quality plating techniques. 2-3 sentences.]
  • Flavor Boosters: [The one unexpected addition that elevates the whole dish. 2-3 sentences.]

Nutrition Facts and Health Benefits

[Detailed nutrition breakdown paragraph: specific calories per serving, protein grams, fat grams, carbs, fiber, key vitamins A/C/D/E/K/B12, minerals like iron/calcium/potassium/zinc. Reference real numbers. 4-5 sentences.]

[Health benefit paragraph: which nutrients support which body functions - immune health, bone density, energy, heart health, etc. Back with food science. 4-5 sentences.]

[Dietary adaptations paragraph: how to make it vegan, gluten-free, low-carb, low-sodium, dairy-free. Specific ingredient substitutions. 4-5 sentences.]

Creative Variations Worth Trying

[Intro paragraph about how recipes evolve. 1-2 sentences.]

[Variation 1 with name and specific ingredient changes. 2-3 sentences.]

[Variation 2 with different cuisine influence. 2-3 sentences.]

[Variation 3 with seasonal twist. 2-3 sentences.]

[Variation 4 with meal prep version. 2-3 sentences.]

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I make this ahead of time and how should I store it?

[Detailed answer about make-ahead prep, storage containers, how long it keeps in fridge vs freezer, reheating best practices with temperatures. 4-5 sentences.]

What can I serve alongside this dish to make it a complete meal?

[Specific pairing suggestions for sides, drinks, bread, etc. Explain why these pairings work. 4-5 sentences.]

Why did my dish turn out [common problem] and how do I fix it?

[Address the most common mistake beginners make, explain the food science behind why it happens, and give step-by-step fix. 4-5 sentences.]

What are the best ingredient substitutions if I'm missing something?

[Comprehensive list of substitutions with ratios and any technique adjustments needed. 4-5 sentences.]

Final Thoughts from the Kitchen

[Personal, warm closing paragraph: your genuine love for this dish, emotional connection, encouragement to try. 3-4 sentences.]

[Call to action: encourage experimenting, invite them to share results. 2-3 sentences.]

===END=== CRITICAL REMINDER: 1500-1800 words. CATEGORY must be ${forcedCatId}. Sound human and passionate. No em-dashes. No Wikipedia. Complete every section fully.`; return [{ json: { ...d, _mistralBody: { model: 'mistral-small-latest', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt }], max_tokens: 8192, temperature: 0.75 }, _geminiBody: { contents: [{ parts: [{ text: prompt }] }], generationConfig: { maxOutputTokens: 8192, temperature: 0.75 }, safetySettings: [ { category: 'HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT', threshold: 'BLOCK_NONE' }, { category: 'HARM_CATEGORY_HATE_SPEECH', threshold: 'BLOCK_NONE' }, { category: 'HARM_CATEGORY_SEXUALLY_EXPLICIT', threshold: 'BLOCK_NONE' }, { category: 'HARM_CATEGORY_DANGEROUS_CONTENT', threshold: 'BLOCK_NONE' } ] } } }];
